# FABILAND


networks for ggplots
```{r}
net_total <-  list(annotate("segment", x = -10000, xend =10000,
           y = c(-10000,-5000, 0, 5000,10000),
           yend = c(-10000,-5000, 0, 5000,10000)),
  annotate("segment", y = -10000, yend =10000,
           x = c(-10000,-5000, 0, 5000,10000),
           xend = c(-10000,-5000, 0, 5000,10000)) )


net_autofrei <-  list(annotate("segment", x = -5000, xend =5000,
           y = c(-5000, 0, 5000),
           yend = c(-5000, 0, 5000), col = "red"),
  annotate("segment", y = -5000, yend =5000,
           x = c(-5000, 0, 5000),
           xend = c(-5000, 0, 5000),col = "red") )

```


Read Data
```{r}

base_dir <- "/Users/jakob/git/silo/useCases/fabiland/scenario/scenOutput/2026-09-11b-base/"
policy_dir <- "/Users/jakob/git/silo/useCases/fabiland/scenario/scenOutput/2026-09-11b-policy/"
year <- 5
base_pp <- read_csv(paste0(base_dir,"microData/pp_",year,".csv"))
base_hh <- read_csv(paste0(base_dir,"microData/hh_",year,".csv"))
base_dd <- read_csv(paste0(base_dir,"microData/dd_",year,".csv"))
base_jj <- read_csv(paste0(base_dir,"microData/jj_",year,".csv"))


policy_pp <- read_csv(paste0(policy_dir,"microData/pp_",year,".csv"))
policy_hh <- read_csv(paste0(policy_dir,"microData/hh_",year,".csv"))
policy_dd <- read_csv(paste0(policy_dir,"microData/dd_",year,".csv"))
policy_jj <- read_csv(paste0(policy_dir,"microData/jj_",year,".csv"))
```

Merge Dataset
```{r}
base_merged <- base_pp |> left_join(base_hh, by = c("hhid" = "id")) |> left_join(base_dd, by = c("hhid"="id")) |> left_join(base_jj |> select(id = personId, jobX = coordX, jobY = coordY))



policy_merged <- policy_pp |> left_join(policy_hh, by = c("hhid" = "id")) |> left_join(policy_dd, by = c("hhid"="id")) |> 
  left_join(policy_jj |> select(id = personId, jobX = coordX, jobY = coordY))
```


Plot Jobs
```{r}
base_merged |> ggplot() + geom_point(aes(jobX,jobY), alpha = 0.1) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + labs(title = "Base")
policy_merged |> ggplot() + geom_point(aes(jobX,jobY), alpha = 0.1) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + labs(title = "Policy")


zonal_counts_jobs <- base_merged |>
  select(id, jobX, jobY) |> 
 
  mutate(scenario = "base") |> 
  bind_rows(policy_merged |> select(id,jobX, jobY) |> mutate(scenario = "policy")) |>
  filter(!is.na(jobX)) |>
  mutate(coordX = round(jobX/5000) *5000, coordY = round(jobY/5000) *5000) |> 
  group_by(coordX, coordY,scenario) |> count()


zonal_counts_jobs |> 
  filter(scenario == "base") |> 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_point(aes(coordX,coordY, size = n)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Base Counts")
  
zonal_counts_jobs |> 
  filter(scenario == "policy") |> 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_point(aes(coordX,coordY, size = n)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Policy Counts")


zonal_counts_jobs |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = n) |>
  mutate(diff = policy - base) |>
  ggplot() +
  net_total +
  net_autofrei +
  geom_point(aes(coordX, coordY, fill = diff), size = 10,shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red",
    mid = "white",
    high = "blue",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Policy - Base", fill = "Job Diff") 

```

```{r}
# sanity check
base_merged |> full_join(policy_merged, by = "id", suffix = c(".base",".policy")) |> 
  mutate(age_same = age.base == age.policy, gender_same = gender.base == gender.policy) |> filter(!age_same)


# People moving away from carfree zone
base_merged |> full_join(policy_merged, by = "id", suffix = c(".base",".policy")) |> 
  filter(age.base == age.policy & gender.base == gender.policy) |> 
  mutate(coordX.base = round(coordX.base/5000) *5000, coordY.base = round(coordY.base/5000) *5000) |> 
  mutate(coordX.policy = round(coordX.policy/5000) *5000, coordY.policy = round(coordY.policy/5000) *5000) |> 
  mutate(jobX.base = round(jobX.base/5000) *5000, jobY.base = round(jobY.base/5000) *5000) |> 
  mutate(jobX.policy = round(jobX.policy/5000) *5000, jobY.policy = round(jobY.policy/5000) *5000) |> 
 filter(coordX.base == 0 & coordY.base == 0) |> 
  mutate(category = case_when(
  is.na(coordX.policy) ~ "disappeared",
  coordX.policy == 0 & coordY.policy == 0 ~ "stayed",
  .default = "movedFromCBA"
)) |> 
  mutate(job_in_cba = jobX.base == 0 & jobY.base == 0) |>
  group_by(category) |> 
  summarise(n = n(),  income.base = mean(income.base), drivers_license = mean(driversLicense.base == TRUE), job_in_cba =mean(job_in_cba == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),has_car = mean(autos.base > 0))

# People moving to carfree zone
base_merged |> full_join(policy_merged, by = "id", suffix = c(".base",".policy")) |> 
  filter(age.base == age.policy & gender.base == gender.policy) |> 
  mutate(coordX.base = round(coordX.base/5000) *5000, coordY.base = round(coordY.base/5000) *5000) |> 
  mutate(coordX.policy = round(coordX.policy/5000) *5000, coordY.policy = round(coordY.policy/5000) *5000) |>
  mutate(jobX.base = round(jobX.base/5000) *5000, jobY.base = round(jobY.base/5000) *5000) |> 
  mutate(jobX.policy = round(jobX.policy/5000) *5000, jobY.policy = round(jobY.policy/5000) *5000) |> 
 filter(coordX.policy == 0 & coordY.policy == 0) |> 
  mutate(category = case_when(
  is.na(coordX.base) ~ "appeared",
  coordX.base == 0 & coordY.base == 0 ~ "stayed",
  .default = "moved2CBA"
)) |>  mutate(job_in_cba = jobX.base == 0 & jobY.base == 0) |> 
  group_by(category) |> 
  summarise(n = n(),  income.base = mean(income.base), drivers_license = mean(driversLicense.base == TRUE), job_in_cba =mean(job_in_cba == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), has_car = mean(autos.base > 0))


```


## Skims

```{r}
base_dir <- "/Users/jakob/git/silo/useCases/fabiland/scenario/scenOutput/2026-09-10a-base/"
# policy_dir <- "/Users/jakob/git/silo/useCases/fabiland/scenario/scenOutput/2026-09-10a-policy/"

# base_dir <- "/Users/jakob/git/silo/useCases/fabiland/scenario/scenOutput/2026-09-11a-base/"
policy_dir <- "/Users/jakob/git/silo/useCases/fabiland/scenario/scenOutput/2026-09-11b-policy/"

year <- 5
base_car_skim <- read_csv(paste0(base_dir,"matsim/skims/carSkim_",year,".csv"))
policy_car_skim <- read_csv(paste0(policy_dir, "matsim/skims/carSkim_",year,".csv"))
base_pt_skim <- read_csv(paste0(base_dir, "matsim/skims/ptSkim_",year,".csv"))
policy_pt_skim <- read_csv(paste0(policy_dir, "matsim/skims/ptSkim_",year,".csv"))


fabiland_shp <- read_sf("/Users/jakob/git/silo/useCases/fabiland/scenario/input/zonesShapefile/fabiland.shp")

from_node = 5

base_car_skim |> filter(FROM  == from_node) |> left_join(fabiland_shp, by = c("TO" = "Id")) |> st_as_sf() |> tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "VALUE") + tm_title("Base - Car")

policy_car_skim |> filter(FROM  == from_node) |> left_join(fabiland_shp, by = c("TO" = "Id")) |> st_as_sf() |> tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "VALUE") + tm_title("Policy - Car")


base_pt_skim |> filter(FROM  == from_node) |> left_join(fabiland_shp, by = c("TO" = "Id")) |>  
st_as_sf() |> tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "VALUE") + tm_title("Base - PT")

policy_pt_skim |> filter(FROM  == from_node) |> left_join(fabiland_shp, by = c("TO" = "Id")) |> st_as_sf() |> tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "VALUE") + tm_title("Policy - PT")

```
